newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares slip on politics, but rise off lows.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares slip on politics, but rise off lows.

text.p: Istanbul shares fell amid renewed concerns over the fate of the Islamist-led coalition government on Friday, but recovered part of the earlier losses on support, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 closed 16 points, or 1.1 percent lower at 1,443 after rebounding from a low of 1,426. Over the week it firmed 0.84 percent, with the help of a 6.2 percent upward correction on Tuesday and Wednesday.
Daily trade volume shrank to 8.83 trillion lira from Thursday's 14.84 trillion.
